AllocateIpRequest.description:
Body for ``POST /subnets/{id}/allocations``.

``kind`` controls behaviour:
* ``dynamic`` — controller picks the next free IP (``ip_address`` ignored)
* ``reservation`` — caller pins ``ip_address`` (must be supplied)
AllocateIpRequest.title: AllocateIpRequest

EnrollmentTokenIssueResponse.description:
Operator response after issuing an enrolment token.

``token`` is the plaintext to hand to the agent; it is never exposed
again. ``expires_at`` lets the operator see how long they have to
transfer it.
EnrollmentTokenIssueResponse.title: EnrollmentTokenIssueResponse

NetworkCreateResponse.description: Combined envelope: the resource ``and`` the operation that produced it.
NetworkCreateResponse.title: NetworkCreateResponse

NetworkUpdateRequest.description: PATCH body — fields left out are not changed.
NetworkUpdateRequest.title: NetworkUpdateRequest

NodeCapabilitiesIO.description:
Wire shape for ``NodeCapabilities`` — both request (enroll/heartbeat)
and response (node read) use the same DTO so the agent doesn't need to
learn two formats.
NodeCapabilitiesIO.title: NodeCapabilitiesIO

NodeStatus.description:
Lifecycle of a managed node as seen by the controller.

``pending``  — enrolment token issued, agent has not yet contacted us.
``online``   — recent heartbeat, agent ready.
``stale``    — last heartbeat older than the stale threshold.
``offline``  — last heartbeat older than the offline threshold.
``draining`` — node is being decommissioned, do not schedule new workloads.
NodeStatus.title: NodeStatus

OperationKind.description: What domain action an operation represents.
OperationKind.title: OperationKind

OperationStatus.description:
Async operation lifecycle.

State machine (terminal states marked ``*``)::

    accepted → planning → running → verifying → succeeded*
                                             ↘ failed*
                                             ↘ rolled_back*
                                 ↘ cancelled*
OperationStatus.title: OperationStatus

ServiceTokenIssueResponse.title: ServiceTokenIssueResponse

ServiceTokenOut.description: Без plaintext — plaintext отдаётся ровно один раз в ``IssueResponse``.
ServiceTokenOut.title: ServiceTokenOut

SnapshotResponse.description:
``GET /events/snapshot`` — полное состояние + watermark.

Подписчик идёт сюда при первичной синхронизации, фиксирует
``event_id``, потом подключается к webhook'ам или к ``GET /events
?since=<event_id>`` и не пропускает ничего.
SnapshotResponse.title: SnapshotResponse
